Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates whether a model can solve real-world software engineering issues by generating a code patch in a Python repository such that the project’s tests pass. Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Logical Reasoning, Planning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility
